about: A message as SES v2's SendEmail takes it, as FF reads and makes it: the table the backend's L1 (email-send.spec.ts) and ff local's mail read for their tests, so that both read a request alike and make the same message of it. `addresses` are lists as a header or the API writes them, each address in lower case, null for one that is no address; `senders`, a sender's one address, null for none or more than one; `headers`, a request's own header and why it can't be the message's, null when it can; `raw`, a raw message's sender and recipients as its header names them, and the message without its Bcc. `composed` is simple content made into a message, as a reader shows it: each header field's value unfolded, its encoded words decoded, `{id}` the message's ID and `{host}` the SES endpoint's; the fields it hasn't; its type, and each part's type and body, decoded. `written` is how the backend's nodemailer writes a field, which ff local needn't: the backend's alone.

addresses.title: a name with a comma in quotes, an address alone, and words that are no address

senders.title: a name and its address, in lower case

headers.title: the sender
headers.name: From
headers.problem: From is a header SES writes itself

headers.title: a signature
headers.name: DKIM-Signature
headers.problem: DKIM-Signature is a header SES writes itself

headers.title: a value that would add a header
headers.name: X-Bad
headers.problem: X-Bad's value is one line of 870 characters at most

headers.title: a name with a space
headers.name: Bad Name
headers.problem: "Bad Name" is not a header's name

raw.title: recipients folded over two lines, a Bcc folded with a tab, and a body line that looks like one
raw.message:
From: Ana <orders@shop.example.tn>
To: a@example.tn,
 b@example.tn
Bcc: hidden@example.tn,
	other@example.tn
Subject: Hi

Bcc: in the body stays
raw.withoutBcc:
From: Ana <orders@shop.example.tn>
To: a@example.tn,
 b@example.tn
Subject: Hi

Bcc: in the body stays

raw.title: a Bcc as the header's last field
no Bcc: the message as it came

composed.title: a subject in another alphabet, both bodies as alternatives, the request's own header, and no Bcc
